source.title: Induction of vertebrate regeneration by a transient sodium current.
source.location: Results, 'Early control of regenerative processes by sodium influx' (first 24 hpa sentence)

injury: tail amputation at midpoint between anus and tail tip

intervention.description: Amputated tails in water with 250 uM MS222 for the first 24 h after amputation, then culture in 0.1x MMR.

readout.method: scoring of tail regeneration by regeneration category

notes: Text: MS222 for the first 24 hpa prevented tail regeneration in 45% of tadpoles (n = 106). Count derived as 45% of 106 = 47.7, rounded to 48. Only the no-regeneration share is reported in the text; the remaining animals are not split into full or partial, so the counts do not sum to n. n_total left null because the validator requires counts to sum to n_total. Composite regeneration index is not used as counts.

source.title: Induction of vertebrate regeneration by a transient sodium current.
source.location: Results, 'Early control of regenerative processes by sodium influx' (first 48 hpa sentence)

injury: tail amputation at midpoint between anus and tail tip

intervention.description: Amputated tails in water with 250 uM MS222 for the first 48 h after amputation, then culture in 0.1x MMR.

readout.method: scoring of tail regeneration by regeneration category

notes: Text: 78% of tails failed to regenerate with MS222 for the first 48 hpa (n = 105). Count derived as 78% of 105 = 81.9, rounded to 82. Only the no-regeneration share is reported; full and partial not split. n_total null for the same reason as the 24 hpa row.

source.title: Induction of vertebrate regeneration by a transient sodium current.
source.location: Results, 'Early control of regenerative processes by sodium influx' (24 hpa addition sentence)

injury: tail amputation at midpoint between anus and tail tip

intervention.description: Amputated tails given 250 uM MS222 starting at 24 h after amputation.

readout.method: scoring of tail regeneration by regeneration category

notes: Text: MS222 treatment targeting NaV activity at 24 hpa resulted in 26% regenerative failure (n = 107). Count derived as 26% of 107 = 27.8, rounded to 28. Duration of exposure is not stated. Only the failure share is reported; n_total null for the same reason as above.
